name: @navopw/opencode-notch
description: Dynamic Island-style macOS notch notifications for OpenCode
author: Stanislav Hetzel

scripts.build:swift: rm -rf swift/notch.app swift/notch && mkdir -p swift/notch.app/Contents/MacOS && swiftc -O -swift-version 5 -parse-as-library -target arm64-apple-macos13.0 -o swift/notch.app/Contents/MacOS/notch swift/notch.swift && cp swift/Info.plist swift/notch.app/Contents/Info.plist && codesign --force --deep --sign - swift/notch.app
scripts.prepack: bun run build && bun run build:swift
